children: Alexandria Flour Mills posted an 18% year-on-year (YoY) decline in net profits from continuing operations of EGP 44.414 million in fiscal year (FY) 2025/2026, compared to EGP 54.165 million, according to the financial results.
Sales increased to EGP 384.356 million at the end of June 2026 from EGP 372.404 million in FY2024/2025.
Established in 1965, the company specializes in manufacturing, trading, importing, and exporting, as well as packaging and distributing grains and their products and substitutes.
